g.text: Lesson 2.7 relay stage: PB0 (1 Hz, 0 / 3.3 V) -> 10 kOhm -> BC547B -> module IN, 10 kOhm pull-up to 5 V
BC547B the right way round: IN 5 V <-> about 0 V, the relay clicks
outer legs swapped (C and E reversed): IN hardly moves, the relay stays off
relay module inside (1 kOhm, PNP, 70 Ohm coil, diode, LED): typical values, not measured
